validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <datamodel><data id="x" expr="1"/><data id="y" expr="2"/></datamodel>
  <state id="a">
    <onentry>
      <log expr="# Retry loop"/>
      <log expr="x @ y"/>
      <log expr="Starting…"/>
      <log expr="😀 hi"/>
      <log expr="Error: failed"/>
      <log expr="it's done"/>
      <log expr="x.#secret"/>
      <log expr="// counts attempts"/>
      <log expr="`total"/>
      <script>
        # Update the counter
        x = x + 1;
      </script>
    </onentry>
    <transition event="go" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: ecmascript syntax error in `expr`: `#` does not start a comment or a heading in an ECMAScript expression
notes: an expression that cannot be parsed raises `error.execution` whenever it is evaluated
diagnostics.help: text in an expression must be a quoted string literal: write `'# Retry loop'`

fixes.message: quote the text as a string literal

notes: an expression that cannot be parsed raises `error.execution` whenever it is evaluated
diagnostics.help: text in an expression must be a quoted string literal: write `'x @ y'`

fixes.message: quote the text as a string literal

diagnostics.help: an `expr` must produce a value: write the expression, or move the comment into a `<script>` or an XML comment `<!-- … -->`
